name: 99004 · Cheney, WA
findings: ZIP 99004 (Cheney) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99004 (Cheney) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
